calx.description:
This open-source Flutter project, developed using Antigravity®, features a modern Material 3 Expressive interface. The application is AI-assisted and designed for high utility, offering:

Core Functionality: Voice-based calculations, comprehensive unit conversions, and a built-in constants table.
Customization: Fully integrated dynamic app themes.
Development: Architected with Flutter, emphasizing performance and clean, AI-supervised implementation.
